basic_info.description: $126k Reduction! This bright and modern upper-floor Hayes Valley condominium offers contemporary living in a well-maintained elevator building built in 2010. The spacious 1 bed/1 bath/ 870 sqft (per tax records) home features air conditioning, sleek hardwood floors, and a generous bedroom with a walk-in closet. The modern kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances, including a Bertazzoni gas range, Bosch dishwasher and microwave, and elegant quartz countertops. A convenient in-home washer and dryer add to the home's practicality. The unit includes 1 car (SUV-sized!) deeded parking space with an EV charger, and residents enjoy access to a shared common courtyard. Hayes Valley is a dynamic neighborhood known for its chic boutiques, world-class dining, and thriving arts scene. This flat and walkable enclave offers a perfect blend of historic charm and modern sophistication, making it one of the city's most desirable places to live. 100 Walk & Transit Scores, 99 Bike Score. Leave your car in the garage and explore all that your new neighborhood has to offer. Monthly fees are $877.20 (per HOA), 32 unit condominium building.
